recipes.name: Baked Berry & Pecan Oatmeal
instructions: Lightly grease a 9 x 12 inch (23 x 31 cm) baking dish and preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C)*.
Add the flaxseeds and water to a large bowl. Mix and let rest for 5 minutes to gel.
Add the bananas to the bowl and mash well. Then add the milk and vanilla, and stir to combine.
Then add all the oats, cinnamon, baking powder, salt, and pecans. Mix.
Gently fold in the blueberries and strawberries.
Pour the mixture into the baking dish. If desired, decorate the top with some more berries and pecans. Bake on the centre rack of the oven for 35 to 40 minutes, or until firm and lightly golden.
When removed from the oven, allow it to cool for a few minutes before slicing. Add desired toppings, like yogurt and nut butter, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Nutrition tip: aim to use a plant-based milk that is fortified with calcium . * We used top and bottom heating (not fan-assisted/convection).

Storage Best if enjoyed immediately. The baked oatmeal can be stored in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days. This baked oatmeal can also be cut-up and stored in the freezer for up to 1 month.
